# capella.yaml reference

<!-- Generated by `cbdev docs reference` from internal/config/capellafile/schema.json; do not edit by hand. Run `make docs`. -->

Every field cbctl reads from `capella.yaml`, generated from the schema that `cbctl capella validate` uses. The same details are shown offline by `cbctl capella guide config FIELD`.

**Changes** says what happens when the value is changed in the file and applied:

- **updatable**: changing the value in the file updates the resource in place
- **immutable**: cannot change after create; remove and recreate
- **key**: identifies the resource; rename is a replace
- **re-created**: any change deletes and recreates the resource
- **rotate only**: password/token fields that rotate rather than update
- **cbctl only**: managed only by cbctl (not sent to Capella)

The single-project form (`project:` and `clusters:` at the top level) uses the same fields as `projects[].…`.

## (top level)

| Field | Type | Default | Changes | API | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `apiVersion` | string: `cbctl/v1`, `capellactl/v1` |  | cbctl only |  | File format version: cbctl/v1 (files written by cbctl). capellactl/v1 files are accepted unchanged. |
| `clusters` | list of values |  |  |  | Clusters of the project (single-project form; prefer projects[].clusters). |
| `credentialsOutput` | string | `./.cbctl/credentials` | cbctl only |  | Directory where Capella-generated passwords are saved (mode 0600). |
| `organizationId` | string |  | key |  | Capella organization ID. Usually ${CAPELLA_ORG_ID}; may come from a profile instead. |
| `project.description` | string |  | updatable | description (Create/Update Project) | Project description (up to 256 characters). |
| `project.id` | string |  | key |  | Pin the project by ID (needed only when several projects share the name). |
| `project.name` | string |  | key | name (Create/Update Project) | Project name (up to 128 characters). Identifies the project in the organization. |
| `projects` | list of objects |  |  |  | Projects in the organization, each with its clusters. |
| `projects.clusters` | list of values |  |  |  | Clusters in this project. |
| `projects.description` | string |  | updatable | description (Create/Update Project) | Project description (up to 256 characters). |
| `projects.id` | string |  | key |  | Pin the project by ID (needed only when several projects share the name). |
| `projects.name` | string |  | key | name (Create/Update Project) | Project name (up to 128 characters). Identifies the project in the organization. |
| `skipProjects` | list of string |  | cbctl only | none (capellactl only) | Projects that 'capellactl sync' leaves out (set with 'capellactl sync --skip-project NAME'; 'capellactl sync --project NAME' brings one back). |
